whereabouts: Dr Vauthier dined at the house with the family on the last day of the year, as he does every year.
At nine o'clock at dinner, Dr Vauthier was with the family and Aurèle, who had everyone show him their watches.
Dr Vauthier and Madame Monnier sat down to piquet in the salon after dinner.
Dr Vauthier was in the salon playing piquet with Madame Monnier when the temple struck ten.
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall at a quarter to eleven by his watch, to fetch his cigar case from his coat.
Madame Monnier began to play the piano in the salon as Dr Vauthier went out to the hall.
Madame Monnier stopped playing the piano when Dr Vauthier came back.
Dr Vauthier fetched his cigar case himself.
Dr Vauthier is in the dining room for this interview and has his cigar case with him.
